shared_elements: horizontal linear bands crossing the field
repeated small vertical strokes in a row
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic engraved linework including a disc/circle, horizontal banded lines and rows of small repeated strokes, which is about as generic as such correspondences get. A depicts a single large anthropomorphic sculpted body with a headdress and ornaments arranged on the torso, while B depicts a scattered field of crewed boats with upturned prows, animals and tiny stick figures — different subjects and completely different compositional logic.
